product_family: Enterprise AI platform offering generative models (Command, Transcribe, North), retrieval models (Embed, Rerank), and workplace systems (North, Compass) for text, code, and speech tasks with options for private deployment, custom fine-tuning, and on-premises hosting.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Cohere undergoes an annual SOC 2 Type II audit covering Service Organization Controls (Type II) Trust Services Principles.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Cohere obtained ISO 27001 certification (cybersecurity standards) on June 27, 2025, demonstrating commitment to meet the highest global standards in cybersecurity.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: Cohere obtained ISO 42001 certification (responsible AI standards) on June 27, 2025, demonstrating commitment to the highest global standards in responsible AI.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Cohere has designed its services with Privacy-by-Design in mind and has Data Processing Agreements with Standard Contractual Clauses. The company conducted a Transfer Impact Assessment addressing Schrems II ruling for EU data transfers.

certifications.name: HIPAA (Business Associate Agreement)
certifications.proof_quote: Cohere may execute a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for custom model development engagements only; the BAA does not cover Cohere's SaaS services. Organizations should not submit Protected Health Information through hosted products.

privacy.ai_training_note: By default, Cohere collects and de-identifies content submitted for research and development. Enterprise customers can opt out of model training at any time through dashboard settings. Trial and research users' data may be used for model improvement. Enterprise customers should consult separate Enterprise Data Commitments and Data Processing Addendums for specific terms. Cohere provides a Model Training Privacy Notice for detailed information.
privacy.data_region: Canada, United States, United Kingdom. Standard Contractual Clauses used for GDPR-compliant transfers outside EU/EEA.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Supported; verified through continuous monitoring by Secureframe

security.name: Data control & deletion
security.value: On SaaS platform, prompts and generations are automatically deleted after 30 days unless legal requirements or flagged misuse require longer retention; enterprise customers can opt out of model training.

security.name: Deployment options
security.value: VPC (Virtual Private Cloud), on-premises, third-party cloud deployment (where Cohere receives no customer inputs), or managed Model Vault

security.name: Annual penetration testing
security.value: Cohere conducts annual third-party penetration testing and simulated adversarial attacks

security.name: Threat detection
security.value: Advanced threat detection systems monitor for suspicious activity

security.name: Training data lineage tracking
security.value: Cohere maintains training data lineage tracking to prevent poisoning

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: Responsible vulnerability disclosure program in place

security.name: Continuous monitoring
security.source: Monitoring across encryption-in-transit, annual penetration testing, incident response, vendor risk assessments, and physical security through Secureframe

products.name: Command
products.data_scope: Customer inputs and outputs. Can opt out of training use. 30-day auto-deletion on SaaS.
products.notes: High-performance models for agentic, multimodal, multilingual AI. Supports 49 languages.

products.name: Transcribe
products.data_scope: Audio inputs and transcription outputs. Subject to same data commitments as Command.
products.notes: Speech-to-text model for audio transcription. Supports 14 languages.

products.name: North
products.data_scope: Customer data within North platform. Deployable privately or in VPC.
products.notes: Enterprise-ready workplace productivity platform with customizable AI capabilities.

products.name: Compass
products.data_scope: Customer business data and search queries. Deployable privately.
products.notes: Intelligent search and discovery system for surfacing business insights.

products.name: Embed
products.data_scope: Customer text embeddings for search/retrieval. Subject to standard data commitments.
products.notes: Multimodal semantic search and retrieval tool. Built with customer data in customer environment.

products.name: Rerank
products.data_scope: Search ranking operations. Data subject to standard commitments.
products.notes: Semantic boost for search relevance ranking.

products.data_scope: Customer proprietary training data. Can include HIPAA data under BAA for custom models only.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscriptions with pay-as-you-go API pricing; enterprise custom pricing available

compare.trains_on_data_notes: By default yes for trial/research users. Enterprise: opt-out available. Custom model development: only on customer data with explicit engagement.

flags: HIPAA scope is narrow: BAA available for custom model development only, not for SaaS services. Healthcare users should NOT submit PHI to hosted products without custom engagement.
ISO 42001 certification (June 2025) is excellent but relatively recent—verify current status for future assessments.
Data residency flexible but requires explicit deployment choice; default SaaS may process data across Canada/US/UK.
No evidence of CSA STAR, FedRAMP, PCI DSS, or ISO 27017/27018—appropriate for general AI use but may limit some verticals (financial, healthcare, government).
Model training opt-out available for enterprise but is an opt-out (not default privacy), and applies to enterprise only—trial/research users default to permissive training.
